title: Magnetic locks and impeded egress in supportive-living building (Council Order 0015437)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the redacted order

facts.text: The case describes a 3,930 m², sprinklered, two-storey combustible building divided into four buildings by two-hour firewalls, intended for Supportive Living Level 4 and Level 4 Dementia residents.
Door magnetic locks did not release after 15 seconds under applied pressure; the applicant proposed an alternative to Clause 3.4.6.15.(4)(e).
The Council record listed a Request for Specific Variance and a Mag Lock Alternative Solution Report with Appendices A–E, but this downloaded file is the decision only.

limitations: The underlying Request for Specific Variance and engineering report are referenced in the order but not separately attached to the public PDF.
